## What is a coworking space in ADGM?

A coworking space in ADGM is a shared, fully serviced workspace inside the Abu Dhabi Global Market jurisdiction where you rent a desk or office by the day, month or year instead of signing a traditional lease. Because it sits within ADGM, the right plan also provides a registered business address for ADGM company registration and licence renewal.

Al Reem Island is part of ADGM, so Aegis Coworking's space in Addax Tower is an ADGM coworking space.

---

## Coworking plans and pricing

### Coworking Day Pass
- Price: AED 100 per day (9 AM–6 PM) or AED 150 for 24-hour access
- Includes: hot desk access, high-speed WiFi, premium coffee and tea, print and scan, all amenities
- Commitment: none — no lease or membership
- Best for: freelancers, remote workers, business travellers, trying the space
- Page: https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/day-pass

### Hot Desk (Flexi Desk)
- Price: from AED 1,000 per month
- Note: Hot Desk and Flexi Desk are the same plan at Aegis
- Includes: any open desk in the shared coworking area, high-speed WiFi, coffee and tea, meeting room credits, community networking
- Commitment: flexible monthly membership
- Best for: remote workers, consultants, SPV and holding-company flexi-desk requirements
- Page: https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/pricing

### Dedicated Desk
- Price: AED 1,150 per month
- One-time fee: AED 1,200 due diligence; ADGM government fees apply separately
- Includes: permanent furnished desk, registered ADGM business address, ADGM-compliant lease agreement, 24/7 secure access, lockable storage, meeting room credits, business lounge
- No deposit, no setup fees, no admin fees, no outgoings, free registration
- Best for: Tech Start-Up and most ADGM operating licences, startups, SMEs
- Page: https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/office-space

### Private Office
- Price: from AED 4,500 per month
- Capacity: 1–20+ people
- Includes: lockable furnished office, registered ADGM business address, 24/7 access, reception, mail handling, meeting rooms
- Best for: FSRA-regulated firms, growing teams, client-facing businesses
- Page: https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/private-office

### Virtual Office
- Price: from AED 292 per month (Basic, Premium and Enterprise packages)
- Includes: registered ADGM address, mail handling and forwarding, company directory listing; higher tiers add UAE phone number, call answering, meeting room credits
- Page: https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/virtual-office

### Meeting Room
- Price: hourly booking, available to members and non-members
- Includes: high-speed WiFi, presentation screen, professional environment
- Page: https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/meeting-room

## Which coworking desk does an ADGM licence need?

| Licence type | Workspace usually required |
|---|---|
| SPV or holding company | Flexi desk |
| Tech Start-Up and most operating licences | Dedicated desk |
| FSRA-regulated activity | Private office |
| No licence — just a place to work | Day pass or hot desk |

Always confirm the final requirement with ADGM Registration Authority or FSRA for your specific activity.

High-speed fibre WiFi; premium coffee and tea; video conference rooms; premium ergonomic chairs; print and scan; mail handling and reception; kitchen and breakout lounge; sea views from the 38th floor; fitness access; beach nearby; secure building access; professional cleaning.

## How to start

1. Choose a desk (day pass, hot desk, dedicated desk or private office)
2. Book a free tour (Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM) or a WhatsApp video walkthrough
3. Complete onboarding (KYC and due diligence; ADGM-ready documents issued)
4. Start working

## Frequently asked questions

### How much does a coworking space in ADGM cost at Aegis?
Day pass AED 100 (9 AM–6 PM) or AED 150 (24 hours); hot desk AED 1,000/month; dedicated desk from AED 1,150/month ; private office from AED 4,500/month.

### Where is the Aegis coworking space in ADGM?
Addax Tower, 3812, Al Reem Island, RT3, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates — inside the ADGM jurisdiction.

### Is Al Reem Island part of ADGM?
Yes. ADGM covers Al Maryah Island and Al Reem Island.

### Can I register an ADGM company with a coworking desk?
Yes. Dedicated desks, private offices and virtual offices include a registered address and ADGM-compliant documents for company registration and licence renewal. Most operating licences need a dedicated desk; FSRA-regulated firms generally need a private office.

### What is the difference between a hot desk and a dedicated desk?
A hot desk lets you use any open desk on a flexible monthly membership. A dedicated desk is your own permanent desk with lockable storage, 24/7 access and a registered ADGM address.

### What is the cheapest coworking option in ADGM at Aegis?
The Day Pass at AED 100. For monthly use, the hot desk at AED 1,000 per month.

### Are there hidden fees or a deposit?
No deposit, setup, admin fees or outgoings; free registration. A one-time AED 1,200 due-diligence fee applies to the dedicated desk; ADGM fees are separate.

### Is 24/7 access available?
Yes, for dedicated desk and private office members. Day pass holders can choose 24-hour access for AED 150.
